intro: Sirra Von'Indi is the resident historian of Darkshire, stationed within the town hall amid stacks of forgotten records. Versed in ancient languages and local history, he assists the township in deciphering mysterious documents and uncovering the dark past of Duskwood.

p: Sirra Von'Indi serves as Darkshire's foremost scholar, keeping watch over the settlement's archives from inside the Darkshire Town Hall. While the town guard focuses on the immediate threats lurking in the woods, Sirra turns his attention to the written word, translating cryptic texts and preserving the fading history of Grand Hamlet before the shadow fell across the region.
